name: Manhattan Loft with Skyline Views
description: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Manhattan skyline from this sleek SoHo loft. The open-plan living space features designer furnishings and a fully equipped kitchen. Subway access and top dining are steps away.

name: Cozy Brooklyn Brownstone
description: A classic Park Slope brownstone with a private garden and three sunny bedrooms. Original hardwood floors and exposed brick add warmth to the thoughtfully decorated interiors. Pets welcome — the fenced garden is perfect for them.

name: Stylish Midtown Studio
description: A compact, well-designed studio in the heart of Midtown, ideal for business travelers or couples exploring the city. The building gym and rooftop access are included. Times Square and Grand Central are both under ten minutes on foot.

name: Private Room Near Central Park
description: A bright, comfortable private room in a shared Upper West Side apartment with a welcoming local host. Central Park is two blocks away and the subway connects you to the whole city. Great value for a Manhattan stay.

name: Tribeca Penthouse Suite
description: A full-floor Tribeca penthouse with wraparound terraces and panoramic views of lower Manhattan. Four bedrooms, a chef's kitchen, and a private elevator make this perfect for groups or family celebrations. Concierge service available on request.

name: Charming Harlem Apartment
description: This cheerful Harlem apartment puts you in the heart of one of New York's most vibrant neighborhoods. Decorated with local art and stocked for a comfortable stay, it includes rare street parking. Great jazz venues and soul food are at your doorstep.

name: Williamsburg Designer Studio
description: A beautifully curated studio in the heart of Williamsburg, steps from the best coffee shops, vintage stores, and music venues Brooklyn has to offer. The private balcony overlooks a tree-lined street. L train access to Manhattan in minutes.

name: West Village Townhouse
description: A picture-perfect West Village townhouse on one of Manhattan's most coveted cobblestone streets. The private garden is ideal for morning coffee, and the working fireplace makes evenings cozy. Within walking distance of the Hudson River and dozens of celebrated restaurants.

name: Victorian Flat in Notting Hill
description: An elegant first-floor flat in a classic Notting Hill Victorian terrace, with high ceilings and original cornicing. The shared garden is a serene retreat from the city buzz. Portobello Road market and the Tube are both minutes away.

name: Richmond Park Riverside Cottage
description: A charming three-bedroom cottage set along the Thames with access to Richmond Park just minutes away. The wood-burning fireplace and enclosed garden make it equally lovely in winter and summer. Dogs and children are genuinely welcome.

name: Shoreditch Creative Studio
description: A bright, industrial-chic studio in the middle of Shoreditch's creative scene. Exposed brick and custom artwork give the space real character. Dozens of independent cafés, galleries, and bars are within a five-minute walk.

name: Private Room in Kensington Home
description: A quiet, comfortable room in a warm family home near Kensington Gardens and the Natural History Museum. Your hosts are seasoned travelers who love sharing local recommendations. An affordable base for exploring central London.

name: Elegant Mayfair Apartment
description: A refined two-bedroom apartment in a white-stucco Mayfair mansion block, furnished with genuine antiques and contemporary art. The building concierge and private gym add to the five-star feel. Steps from Bond Street shopping and Hyde Park.

name: Camden Garden Flat
description: A bright lower-ground-floor flat with its own private garden in lively Camden. The space is thoughtfully styled with mid-century furniture and well-stocked for self-catering. Camden Market, Primrose Hill, and Regent's Canal are all close by.

name: Canary Wharf River View Apartment
description: A sleek modern apartment on the upper floors of a Canary Wharf tower with sweeping Thames views. The building gym, pool, and concierge are available to guests. DLR and Elizabeth line connections make the whole city easily accessible.

name: Painted Lady Victorian in Haight-Ashbury
description: A beautifully preserved Victorian home in Haight-Ashbury with original stained glass, bay windows, and a decorative façade. Four bedrooms spread across three floors can comfortably host larger groups or families. Dolores Park and the Castro are an easy walk.

name: SoMa Designer Loft
description: A converted warehouse loft with polished concrete floors, 14-foot ceilings, and a private balcony in SoMa. The open kitchen is fully equipped for home cooking, and the design throughout is sleek and considered. Close to Caltrain and the Bay Bridge.

name: Nob Hill Studio with Bay Views
description: A cozy hillside studio with partial Bay views and cable car access right outside the door. The neighborhood is quintessentially San Francisco — grand hotels, neighborhood bistros, and dramatic fog rolling in off the water. Perfect for solo travelers or couples.

name: Mission District Sunny Apartment
description: A colorful, sun-drenched apartment in the Mission that benefits from SF's sunniest microclimate. Local murals, taquerias, and independent bookshops fill the streets below. Comes with a rare included parking spot and pets are very welcome.

name: Pacific Heights Private Room
description: A clean, quiet private room in a stately Pacific Heights home shared with a friendly host. The neighborhood is one of SF's most prestigious, with stunning Victorians and views of the bay. Great value for the location.

name: SoMa Penthouse with Rooftop Deck
description: The top floor of a boutique SoMa building with a private rooftop hot tub and 360-degree city views. Three bedrooms and a designer kitchen make this ideal for a group trip to the Bay Area. The building's EV chargers and bike storage are also available to guests.

name: Bernal Heights Cottage with Garden
description: A sweet detached cottage in Bernal Heights with a sunny garden, working fireplace, and a wonderfully local vibe. The hilltop neighborhood offers some of the best views in the city and a tight-knit community of cafés and shops. Dogs happily accommodated.

name: Downtown Condo with CN Tower Views
description: A sleek downtown condo with a direct CN Tower view from the private balcony. The building amenities include a well-equipped gym and rooftop terrace shared with guests. PATH network access from the lobby makes winter exploration effortless.

name: Kensington Market Eclectic Loft
description: A character-filled loft above a vintage shop in the heart of Kensington Market, one of Toronto's most beloved neighbourhoods. The mismatched furniture and local art collection feel genuinely lived-in and warm. Some of the city's best independent food and drink is steps from the door.

name: Annex Victorian Guesthouse
description: A well-maintained Victorian guesthouse in the leafy Annex neighbourhood, close to U of T and Bloor Street shops. Three generous bedrooms and a private garden make it great for families or groups of friends. Street parking included and the subway is a short walk.

name: Yorkville Private Room
description: A comfortable private room in a modern Yorkville apartment shared with a professional host. You're surrounded by Toronto's best boutiques, galleries, and upscale restaurants. The Bloor-Yonge subway station is a short walk.

name: Distillery District Modern Suite
description: A polished one-bedroom suite on the edge of the historic Distillery District, with a balcony overlooking the cobblestone pedestrian streets. Galleries, artisan chocolatiers, and some of Toronto's best brunch spots are on your doorstep. Easy access to the waterfront and downtown core.

name: Mitte Industrial Loft
description: A converted factory space in the heart of Berlin-Mitte with original iron columns and an open, gallery-like atmosphere. The loft spans 85 square metres and comes with a well-equipped kitchen and a small balcony. Museum Island and the Hackescher Markt are a short walk.

name: Prenzlauer Berg Family Apartment
description: A spacious, light-filled apartment in a classic Prenzlauer Berg Altbau building with high ceilings, original parquet floors, and access to a shared courtyard garden. Ideal for families travelling with children — the neighbourhood is full of playgrounds and organic bakeries. Strassenbahn connections are right outside.

name: Kreuzberg Artist Atelier
description: A compact artist's studio apartment in lively Kreuzberg, decorated with the current host's artwork and surrounded by some of Berlin's best street art. Everything you need for a comfortable stay is here, and the neighbourhood's energy is unbeatable. Canal walks and the best döner in the city are just outside.

name: Charlottenburg Belle Époque Apartment
description: A grand turn-of-the-century apartment in western Berlin's elegant Charlottenburg district, with stucco ceilings, tiled stoves, and a large private balcony. Three interconnecting rooms sleep six comfortably. Schloss Charlottenburg, KaDeWe, and the Kurfürstendamm are all nearby.

name: Bondi Beach House
description: A classic Bondi beach house two minutes' walk from the iconic surf beach, with a wraparound balcony perfect for watching the sunrise over the Pacific. The outdoor BBQ and well-stocked kitchen make entertaining a pleasure. Bring your boards — secure surfboard storage is included.

name: Circular Quay Harbour View Apartment
description: Wake up to the Sydney Opera House framed in your bedroom window in this high-floor apartment steps from Circular Quay. The building gym and lap pool are open to guests, and the balcony is an exceptional spot for New Year's Eve fireworks. Ferries to Manly and Taronga Zoo depart from right below.

name: Manly Surf Cottage
description: A laid-back surf cottage in Manly, a short walk from both the ocean beach and the sheltered harbour beach. The outdoor shower and BBQ are well-used after days in the water. The Manly Ferry back to the city is the world's best commute.

name: Surry Hills Private Room
description: A tidy, comfortable private room in Surry Hills shared with a friendly local host. The suburb is packed with excellent cafés, wine bars, and Thai restaurants. Central Station is walkable, making the whole city easy to explore.

name: Mosman Luxury Villa
description: An architecturally designed villa on the Mosman harbourside with a heated pool, spa, and sweeping harbour views. Four bedrooms, multiple living areas, and a chef's kitchen make this an exceptional entertainer's home. A private jetty is available for guests' boats.

name: Orchard Road Modern Apartment
description: A contemporary serviced apartment on the doorstep of Orchard Road's luxury shopping corridor. The condo facilities include a 50-metre pool and a fully equipped gym. Orchard MRT station is a two-minute walk for easy access to the whole island.

name: Marina Bay Studio
description: A compact, well-designed studio with a balcony looking toward Marina Bay Sands and the city skyline. The building amenities are resort-grade and the Gardens by the Bay are a pleasant 15-minute walk. Perfect for a short Singapore stopover or a business trip.

name: Sentosa Island Beachfront Villa
description: A private beachfront villa on Sentosa Island with direct sand access, a temperature-controlled infinity pool, and outdoor entertaining areas. Four en-suite bedrooms and a professional kitchen make this a top choice for family holidays or corporate retreats. Universal Studios and the casino are a short drive.

name: Chinatown Heritage Shophouse
description: A beautifully restored Peranakan shophouse in the heart of Chinatown, blending original tiles and timber with modern comforts. Three bedrooms across three floors suit a small group or family wanting an authentic Singapore base. Hawker centres, temples, and the CBD are all within walking distance.

name: Jardins Modern Apartment
description: A sleek, modern apartment in Jardins — São Paulo's most upscale neighbourhood — surrounded by designer boutiques, world-class restaurants, and excellent bars. The building gym and 24-hour security add to the comfort. Ideal for business or leisure travellers looking to explore Brazil's biggest city.

name: Vila Madalena Artist Loft
description: A compact artist's loft decorated with original prints in the bohemian Vila Madalena neighbourhood, the hub of São Paulo's gallery and nightlife scene. Street art covers the walls of the surrounding streets. The famous Batman Alley is a short stroll away.

name: Itaim Bibi Luxury Penthouse
description: A full-floor penthouse in Itaim Bibi with a rooftop pool, sweeping city views, and interiors by one of São Paulo's top designers. Three suites, a formal dining room, and a chef's kitchen make this SP's finest holiday rental. Concierge and driver services can be arranged.

name: Traditional Machiya in Yanaka
description: A lovingly restored wooden machiya townhouse in Yanaka, one of Tokyo's few surviving pre-war neighbourhoods. Tatami rooms, sliding shoji screens, and a koi garden create an authentic and deeply calming atmosphere. The Yanesen area's galleries, temples, and local shopping streets are a peaceful contrast to central Tokyo.

name: Shibuya High-Rise Studio
description: A compact, efficiently designed studio on an upper floor of a Shibuya high-rise with views of the famous scramble crossing. Everything is clean, modern, and well-thought-out — typical of Japan's best city apartments. Shibuya and Harajuku stations are a short walk.

name: Minami-Aoyama Designer Apartment
description: A beautifully designed two-bedroom apartment in Minami-Aoyama, Tokyo's chicest address, surrounded by galleries, concept stores, and Michelin-starred restaurants. The apartment is furnished with Japanese and Scandinavian pieces that create a serene, considered space. Omotesando station is three minutes on foot.

name: Shinjuku Guestroom
description: An affordable private room in a clean shared apartment a ten-minute walk from Shinjuku Station — one of the world's busiest rail hubs. Your Japanese host offers excellent local dining tips and is happy to help with directions. Golden Gai and Kabukicho are a short walk.

name: Harajuku Stylish Studio
description: A stylish compact studio in Harajuku decorated with Japanese pop art and thoughtfully equipped for a comfortable stay. Takeshita Street's fashion stores, Meiji Shrine, and Yoyogi Park are all a short walk. An excellent base for first-time visitors to Tokyo.

name: Sea Point Ocean View Villa
description: A sleek contemporary villa in Sea Point with a heated pool and direct Atlantic Ocean views from every room. Three bedrooms and a large open-plan living space make entertaining easy, and the outdoor BBQ area is superb. The Sea Point promenade, tidal pool, and Clifton beaches are a short walk.

name: Bo-Kaap Heritage House
description: One of the iconic pastel-painted houses in Bo-Kaap, Cape Town's historic Malay Quarter on the slopes of Signal Hill. The interior is full of character, with hand-painted tiles and a private courtyard garden. The V&A Waterfront, Cape Malay cooking schools, and the city centre are all close by.

name: Clifton Beachfront House
description: An exceptional beachfront house on Clifton's 4th Beach — consistently ranked among the world's most beautiful — with a private pool and direct sand access. The sunset views from the pool deck are extraordinary. This is Cape Town at its very best.

name: Capitol Hill Craftsman Home
description: A classic Seattle Craftsman bungalow in Capitol Hill with original built-ins, hardwood floors, and a covered porch perfect for watching the rain. Three bedrooms sleep six comfortably, and the fireplace is a genuine plus in cooler months. Pike/Pine corridor bars and restaurants are minutes away on foot.

name: Pike Place Market Area Studio
description: A compact studio apartment a three-minute walk from Pike Place Market and the famous fish throwers. The space is efficiently designed and freshly decorated with local Pacific Northwest art. The Seattle waterfront, Olympic Sculpture Park, and the first Starbucks are all within easy walking distance.

name: Treehouse Cabin in Queen Anne
description: A genuinely unique cedar treehouse nestled in a Queen Anne backyard, elevated among mature firs with a private hot tub on the deck. Two cozy bedrooms and a wood-burning stove make this a memorable and romantic getaway. The Space Needle and Seattle Center are a quick drive.

name: Lake Union Houseboat
description: Live like a true Seattleite in this charming floating home on Lake Union, made famous by Sleepless in Seattle. The dock deck is perfect for morning coffee watching kayakers paddle past. Gas Works Park and Fremont's shops and restaurants are a short walk around the lake.

name: Ballard Nordic Cottage
description: A Scandinavian-inspired cottage in Ballard with a cozy fireplace, private garden, and impeccable attention to detail throughout. The neighbourhood's Viking heritage shows in its excellent breweries, smörgåsbords, and the Nordic Heritage Museum nearby. The Hiram M. Chittenden Locks and Shilshole Bay are a short walk.

name: Capitol Hill Victorian Private Room
description: A comfortable private room in a beautifully maintained Victorian home in Capitol Hill, shared with a welcoming host. The lively neighbourhood has something for everyone, from vinyl record shops to rooftop bars. A great budget option in one of Seattle's most walkable areas.

name: East Austin Bungalow with Pool
description: A renovated 1950s bungalow in East Austin with a heated pool, covered back porch, and serious BBQ setup in the backyard. Three bedrooms and an open-plan kitchen-living area work perfectly for a group. Franklin Barbecue, White Horse, and Whisler's are all in the neighbourhood.

name: South Congress Modern Apartment
description: A stylish two-bedroom apartment right on the South Congress strip, surrounded by Austin's best vintage shops, live music venues, and Tex-Mex restaurants. The building is new, the finishes are sharp, and the location is impossible to beat for exploring the city. The Congress Bridge bat colony is a short stroll.

name: Lake Travis Waterfront Cabin
description: A stunning log cabin directly on Lake Travis with a private dock, hot tub, and fire pit overlooking the water. Four bedrooms sleep eight, making this a go-to for bachelor parties, family reunions, and group getaways. Kayaks, paddleboards, and life jackets are all provided.

name: Rainey Street Bar District Studio
description: A clean, comfortable studio steps from the Rainey Street bar district, Austin's most celebrated nightlife corridor of converted bungalows-turned-bars. Perfect for a music festival trip or a long weekend in the city. Zilker Park and Barton Springs Pool are a pleasant bike ride away.

name: Barton Hills Treetop Studio
description: A secluded treetop studio tucked into the live oak canopy above Barton Creek, with a private hot tub and fireplace. An unexpected nature retreat within the city limits, yet minutes from downtown Austin. Barton Springs Pool and the Greenbelt trails are directly accessible from the property.

name: Magnificent Mile High-Rise Suite
description: A polished two-bedroom suite on a high floor of a Magnificent Mile tower with Lake Michigan and city views from the private balcony. The building gym is open 24 hours and the concierge can arrange restaurant reservations and theater tickets. Nordstrom, the Art Institute, and Navy Pier are all within walking distance.

name: Lincoln Park Greystone Home
description: A gorgeous Chicago greystone with original decorative details, a private rear garden, and a working fireplace in the living room. Three bedrooms over two floors work well for families or groups of friends. The Lincoln Park Zoo, Farmers Market, and the lakefront path are all close by.

name: Wicker Park Artisan Loft
description: A two-floor loft apartment in a converted Wicker Park warehouse with exposed brick, timber beams, and a private deck. The neighbourhood is Chicago's creative hub — full of independent record stores, gallery spaces, and the best brunch spots in the city. The Blue Line gets you downtown in 20 minutes.

name: Hyde Park Private Room
description: A quiet private room near the University of Chicago campus and the Museum of Science and Industry. The host is a university faculty member who loves sharing local knowledge. The Metra electric train connects you to the Loop and the lakefront.

name: Andersonville Scandinavian Apartment
description: A cozy, light-filled apartment in Andersonville decorated with Nordic sensibility — clean lines, natural materials, and a warm palette. The neighbourhood is one of Chicago's most welcoming, with excellent Swedish bakeries, independent bookshops, and LGBT-owned businesses. Street parking is included.

name: Gold Coast Luxury Condo
description: A high-end Gold Coast condo with Lake Michigan views from the private terrace and access to a spectacular rooftop pool and fitness center. The finishes are genuinely luxurious — marble bathrooms, custom millwork, and top-of-the-line appliances throughout. Oak Street Beach and Michigan Avenue are steps away.

name: Venice Beach Bungalow
description: A classic California bungalow half a block from Venice Beach, with a private backyard BBQ area and outdoor shower for rinsing off after the surf. The boardwalk's skaters, muralists, and muscle beach are at your doorstep. Rose Avenue's acclaimed restaurants are a five-minute walk.

name: Silver Lake Mid-Century Modern Home
description: An architect-designed 1960s home in Silver Lake with a heated lap pool, original Eames-era furniture, and walls of glass opening onto a landscaped garden. Three bedrooms across a single level create a wonderfully open, connected feel. Sunset Junction's coffee shops and natural wine bars are a short walk.

name: Hollywood Hills Pool Villa
description: A dramatic Hollywood Hills villa cascading down the hillside with an infinity pool, spa, and unobstructed views stretching from downtown to the ocean. Four bedrooms, a screening room, and a professional BBQ station make this a top choice for group trips. The Sunset Strip is ten minutes by car.

name: Malibu Oceanfront Beach House
description: A classic Malibu Colony beach house directly on PCH with private sand access, a wraparound deck, and floor-to-ceiling ocean views. Three bedrooms are styled in relaxed California coastal fashion with linen and driftwood accents. Nobu Malibu and Geoffrey's are both a short drive.

name: Downtown LA Penthouse
description: A top-floor penthouse in the Arts District with sweeping downtown LA skyline views from a private terrace. The building has a rooftop pool, concierge, and a garage. Excellent restaurants, galleries, and the revitalized LA River path are all accessible on foot.

name: Santa Monica Walk-Street Cottage
description: A sun-drenched cottage on one of Santa Monica's rare pedestrian-only walk streets, three blocks from the beach. The private courtyard garden with BBQ is perfect for outdoor living, and the property has a genuine neighborhood feel. The Third Street Promenade and Santa Monica Pier are easily walkable.

name: Echo Park Private Room
description: A comfortable private room in a creative Echo Park home filled with art, plants, and a very friendly dog. The neighbourhood has a great music scene and some of LA's most interesting restaurants and bars. Echo Park Lake is a short walk for morning runs.

name: Beacon Hill Brownstone Suite
description: A gracious Beacon Hill brownstone apartment spread across two floors of a Federal-style building on one of Boston's most photographed streets. Gas lanterns flicker outside the original windows and a wood-burning fireplace warms the living room. The Freedom Trail, Boston Common, and the Public Garden are all a short walk.

name: Back Bay Luxury Apartment
description: A sleek two-bedroom apartment in a boutique Back Bay building with access to a well-equipped gym and a rooftop terrace. Newbury Street's galleries and boutiques are steps away, as is the Boston Public Library. Copley and Prudential T stations are both within easy walking distance.

name: Cambridge Victorian Retreat
description: A three-bedroom Victorian in Cambridge's academic heart, two blocks from Harvard Square and the Charles River. The private garden with Adirondack chairs is a wonderful spot on warm evenings. MIT, the Harvard Museums, and countless excellent restaurants are all within easy reach.

name: South End Historic Row House
description: An impeccably restored South End row house spread over four floors, with a chef's kitchen and working fireplaces on multiple levels. The South End is Boston's most dining-forward neighbourhood — James Beard-winning restaurants are on your block. The layout works perfectly for two families travelling together.

name: Fenway Area Cozy Studio
description: A bright, well-maintained studio in a classic Fenway brownstone that's an easy walk to Fenway Park. The location is ideal for Red Sox fans, medical students, and anyone who wants a central Boston base without paying Back Bay prices. The Emerald Necklace and Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum are nearby.

name: Mountain View Cabin near Red Rocks
description: A warm, well-appointed mountain cabin in the foothills west of Denver with a private hot tub, fire pit, and front-row Rocky Mountain views. Red Rocks Amphitheatre is ten minutes away, making this a perennial favourite for concert weekends. Hiking and mountain biking trails start from the property.

name: Capitol Hill Modern Apartment
description: A smartly renovated apartment in Denver's Capitol Hill with a spacious layout and a included parking spot. The neighbourhood buzzes with independent coffee roasters, bookshops, and dive bars. The State Capitol and Cheesman Park are both within easy walking distance.

name: LoHi Rooftop Loft
description: A top-floor loft in LoHi — Lower Highlands — with a private rooftop deck and outstanding views of downtown Denver and the Front Range. The neighbourhood is Denver's hottest dining and bar scene, with everything from award-winning taquerias to natural wine bars. The Highland Bridge pedestrian walkway connects you to downtown in minutes.

name: RiNo Arts District Studio
description: A clean, well-designed studio in Denver's River North Arts District, surrounded by the city's best murals, breweries, and creative spaces. The unit is on the ground floor of a new build and comes with a private entrance. Denver's best food halls and cocktail bars are all within easy walking or biking distance.

name: South Beach Art Deco Apartment
description: A lovingly restored Art Deco apartment in the heart of South Beach's Historic District, one block from Ocean Drive and the beach. The building's tropical pool is a genuine retreat, and the pastel façades of the neighbourhood make every walk a pleasure. Lincoln Road's restaurants and Española Way are steps away.

name: Coconut Grove Waterfront Villa
description: A grand Coconut Grove villa on Biscayne Bay with a private dock, pool, spa, and lush tropical gardens. Five en-suite bedrooms and multiple entertaining areas make this ideal for large family gatherings or corporate events. The Miami City Club, Vizcaya Museum, and Coconut Grove's village are all close by.

name: Wynwood Arts Loft
description: A gallery-quality loft in Wynwood's celebrated arts district, curated with rotating work from Miami-based artists. The neighbourhood's famous murals, Design District boutiques, and some of Miami's best new restaurants are right outside. Perez Art Museum Miami and Phillip and Patricia Frost Museum of Science are a short drive.

name: Key Biscayne Beach House
description: A spectacular beach house on Key Biscayne with direct Atlantic access, a heated pool, and sunrise views over the water from every bedroom. The island's calm pace and pristine beaches feel miles from the Miami bustle, yet downtown is just 20 minutes by car. Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park is at the end of the road.

name: Brickell City Center Studio
description: A sharp modern studio in Brickell — Miami's financial district — with access to a rooftop pool and a well-equipped gym in the building. Ideal for the business traveler or anyone wanting a sleek urban base. Mary Brickell Village's restaurants and the Brickell City Centre mall are connected by skywalk.

name: Little Havana Colorful Casita
description: A vibrant, plant-filled casita in the heart of Little Havana with a private garden, covered porch, and a genuine neighborhood feel. Calle Ocho's cafecitos, domino parks, and salsa clubs are steps away. A wonderful cultural contrast to South Beach, with great value to match.

name: Gastown Heritage Loft
description: A stunning heritage loft conversion in Gastown with exposed brick walls, 12-foot ceilings, and large industrial windows. Two bedrooms and a spacious open-plan layout suit couples or small groups exploring Vancouver. The Steam Clock, Chinatown, and the best cocktail bars in the city are all within walking distance.

name: Kitsilano Beach House
description: A classic Craftsman home in Kits — two blocks from one of Vancouver's most loved beaches and the outdoor saltwater pool. Three bedrooms and a generous garden with BBQ suit a family holiday or group trip beautifully. The North Shore mountains form a dramatic backdrop, and Granville Island is a short drive.

name: North Shore Mountain Cabin
description: A beautifully built cabin in the North Shore mountains with a private hot tub on the deck, a stone fireplace, and postcard-perfect mountain views. Grouse Mountain's skiing and hiking are five minutes up the road, and the Lions Gate Bridge brings you into downtown Vancouver in 20 minutes. A spectacular four-season retreat.

name: Yaletown High-Rise Studio
description: A polished studio on the upper floors of a Yaletown tower with a private balcony and access to the building's excellent gym and pool. Yaletown's converted warehouse district has Vancouver's best brunches, wine bars, and boutiques. The Seawall walk to Stanley Park starts right at the end of the street.

name: Condesa Art Nouveau Apartment
description: A beautiful apartment in a 1930s Art Nouveau building in La Condesa, one of Mexico City's most charming colonias. The original tilework, arched windows, and access to the building's garden courtyard are genuinely special. Parque México, excellent restaurants, and the best coffee in CDMX are all within walking distance.

name: Roma Norte Colonial Home
description: A stunning early 20th-century colonial home in Roma Norte with a private garden, rooftop terrace, and original Talavera tiles throughout. Three bedrooms and spacious communal areas suit a group wanting a genuine Mexico City home experience. Roma's legendary mezcalerías, gallery openings, and taco stands are steps from the door.

name: Polanco Luxury Suite
description: A sophisticated two-bedroom suite in Polanco, Mexico City's most prestigious neighbourhood, surrounded by Michelin-starred restaurants and luxury boutiques on Presidente Masaryk. Chapultepec Park, the Anthropology Museum, and Soumaya Museum are all within a short walk or ride. Concierge service available.

name: Inman Park Victorian Home
description: A lovingly maintained Victorian home in Inman Park — Atlanta's original garden suburb — with a wraparound porch, private garden, and original heart-pine floors throughout. Three bedrooms and an updated kitchen make it comfortable for families or groups of friends. The BeltLine Eastside Trail connects you to Ponce City Market and beyond.

name: Midtown Studio near Piedmont Park
description: A bright, well-appointed studio a short walk from Piedmont Park and the High Museum of Art in Atlanta's vibrant Midtown. The MARTA Arts Center station is close by for exploring the city without a car. A solid, affordable option for Atlanta visitors who want a central location.

name: Old Fourth Ward Modern Loft
description: A contemporary loft in the Old Fourth Ward with a private balcony overlooking the neighborhood's revitalized streetscape. Ponce City Market, the BeltLine, and a clutch of excellent restaurants are all within easy walking distance. A great base for experiencing Atlanta's creative and culinary renaissance.
